TenantDump.description: The manifest of a tenant dump archive, written by `dump_tenant` and read by `restore_tenant`: where and when the dump was taken, which schema and toolkit it came from, the tenant it holds and the IRI policy that minted its IRIs, so a restore can check that the dump was made under the same schema and policy.

created_at.description: When the dump was taken, so a person choosing among dumps can tell them apart.

format_version.description: The version of the dump archive layout; a restore refuses a version it does not know.

iri_policy.description: The IRI policy of the service; absent, the default policy applies.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

schema_id.description: The id of the LinkML schema whose data the dump holds; a restore checks it against its own.

schema_version.description: The version of that schema, when it declares one.

source_tenant.description: The IRI of the tenant the dump was taken from.

source_tenant_id.description: The id part of the source tenant's IRI, which a restore replaces by the new tenant's id.

toolkit_version.description: The version of the toolkit that wrote the dump.

type.description: The class of the node: its name or IRI. Set by the service on a read; a write may name the class or one of its subclasses.

TenantDump.title: TenantDump

TenantSummary.description: What the service answers about one tenant, in a listing or after creating it.

allowed_actions.description: The actions the caller who asked may take on the tenant, in the order read, modify, delete, administer. Only a listing fills it.

id.description: The IRI that identifies the object.

label.description: The preferred label of the object.

state.description: Where the tenant is in its life.

type.description: The class of the node: its name or IRI. Set by the service on a read; a write may name the class or one of its subclasses.

TenantSummary.title: TenantSummary
